title: Rate Limiting Strategies
description: Apply rate limiting algorithms to protect services.

data.text: Rate limiting protects services from abuse and overload. Different algorithms offer different trade-offs between accuracy and complexity.

terms.definition: Restricting the number of requests a client can make.
An algorithm that allows bursts up to a bucket capacity.
An algorithm that processes requests at a constant rate.
An algorithm that counts requests in a moving time window.

data.text: The token bucket algorithm maintains a bucket of tokens. Each request consumes a token. Tokens refill at a fixed rate. If the bucket is empty, requests are rejected. This allows bursts up to the bucket size.

data.caption: Token Bucket Algorithm
data.definition:
flowchart TD
    Request[Request] --> Check{Tokens > 0?}
    Check -->|Yes| Consume[Consume Token]
    Consume --> Allow[Allow Request]
    Check -->|No| Reject[Reject 429]
    Refill[Refill Timer] -->|Add Tokens| Bucket[(Token Bucket)]
